attackTypes.name: Brawl
attackTypes.description: The body itself: fists, kicks, martial arts, claws, bites, horns, beaks and fangs

attackTypes.name: Bladed
attackTypes.description: Swords, daggers, axes, scythes, and bladed weapons

attackTypes.name: Polearm
attackTypes.description: Spears, lances, halberds, and other long-reach weapons

attackTypes.name: Ranged
attackTypes.description: Bows, crossbows, slings, and other projectile weapons, and directly thrown objects such as knives, rocks, spears and explosives

attackTypes.name: Magic
attackTypes.description: Spells, magical bolts, and supernatural projectiles

attackTypes.name: Blunt
attackTypes.description: Hammers, clubs, maces, and other blunt weapons

attackTypes.name: Breath
attackTypes.description: Fire breath, frost breath, poison spit, acid sprays, and similar emissions

attackTypes.name: Whip
attackTypes.description: Whips, tentacles, tails, vines, and flexible appendages

attackTypes.name: Aura
attackTypes.description: Continuous or pulsing damage fields surrounding the creature

professions.name: Hunter
professions.description: Tracking, hunting, trapping, survival. Includes Ranger, Tracker, Trapper

professions.name: Guardian
professions.description: Defensive abilities, endurance, area protection, battlefield control, and protecting allies: intercepting attacks and taking damage for others. Includes Defender, Tank, Sentinel, Bodyguard

professions.name: Healer
professions.description: Restoring health, cleansing conditions, regeneration, holy protection. Includes Medic, Cleric, Paladin

professions.name: Sorcerer
professions.description: All non-elemental spells: arcane magic, enchantment, magical enhancement, and dark magic such as curses, hexes and life drain. Includes Enchanter, Warlock, Hexer

professions.name: Elementalist
professions.description: Fire, frost, water, storm and earth magic; earth includes stone and crystal. Includes elemental weapons and armor

professions.name: Warrior
professions.description: Offensive martial abilities, endurance, combat mastery. Includes Berserker, Duelist, Knight, Monk

professions.name: Leader
professions.description: Commanding the flow of battle: the shared timeline and Momentum, who acts when, tactical coordination, and moving your own units around the field. Includes Commander, Tactician

professions.name: Rogue
professions.description: Stealth, precision, critical attacks, executing vulnerable targets, deception, illusions, misdirection, sabotage and theft. Includes Assassin, Ninja, Trickster, Illusionist, Thief

professions.name: Tinker
professions.description: Making things: potions, chemicals, poisons, mixtures, machinery, gadgets, constructs, mechanical traps. Includes Alchemist, Herbalist, Poisoner, Engineer, Artificer

professions.name: Summoner
professions.description: Summoning and commanding additional creatures, spirits, entities, or constructs, including necromancy: raising the dead and bone constructs. Includes Beastmaster, Necromancer

professions.name: Primalist
professions.description: Primal nature and the soul: plants, roots, beasts, shapeshifting, totems, nature spirits, rituals and life force. Spirits of the dead belong to Summoner. Includes Druid, Shaman

professions.name: Flying
professions.description: Flight, aerial mobility, evasive maneuvers, dive attacks, and airborne combat advantages
